# `select.shrink`: Shrink group

Removes the outermost rings of elements from a group.

- Category: select
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(n + H) for any step count
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups
- Also known as: select less, shrink selection, ctrl minus

The inverse of `select.grow`: removes elements that touch anything outside the group, `steps` times.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | `string` | required | Group to grow or shrink. |
| `save_as` | `string \| null` | `null` | Store the result under this name instead of changing the group. |
| `steps` | `number` | `1` | Rings of neighbours to add or remove. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"group":"top","save_as":"top_inner","target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): shrank group top_inner (0 faces)`
